career_ladder.note: Sub-Inspectors of Police (SI) are directly recruited executive officers in the Odisha Police. They serve as Investigating Officers (IO) and Officers-in-Charge (OIC) of police stations. Career advancement follows the Odisha Police Subordinate Service Rules and Odisha Police Service (OPS) Rules.

exam_scheme.note: The Odisha Police Sub-Inspector recruitment consists of three main stages: a Computer Based Recruitment Examination (CBRE) comprising two objective papers, followed by Physical Standard Measurement (PSM) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), concluding with Document Verification and Medical Examination.

stages.stage_name: Stage I: Computer Based Recruitment Examination (CBRE)
stages.source_label: Odisha Police Recruitment Board Sub-Inspector Scheme of Examination

papers.paper_name: Paper I: General English & Odia Language (General English 50 Q / 50 marks, Odia Language 50 Q / 50 marks)
papers.negative_marking: 0.25 marks deducted per incorrect answer (1/4th penalty)

papers.paper_name: Paper II: General Studies, Reasoning, Mental Ability & Basic Computer (General Studies 100 Q / 100 marks, Reasoning & Mental Ability 70 Q / 70 marks, Basic Computer 30 Q / 30 marks)
papers.negative_marking: 0.25 marks deducted per incorrect answer (1/4th penalty)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Combined aggregate minimum qualifying marks: 35% for SC/ST, 40% for General and SEBC candidates

stages.stage_name: Stage II: Physical Standard Measurement (PSM) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
stages.source_label: Odisha Police SI Physical Standards and Fitness Test Rules

papers.paper_name: Physical Standards Measurement & Physical Efficiency (Run: Men 1.6 km in 8 min, Women 1.6 km in 10 min; Long Jump: Men 3.66m in 3 attempts, Women 2.77m in 3 attempts; Height & Chest verification)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying in nature; mandatory clearance of prescribed physical benchmarks

stages.stage_name: Stage III: Document Verification & Medical Board Examination
stages.source_label: Odisha Police SI Medical Board Guidelines and Verification Process

papers.paper_name: Original Certificate Verification and Detailed Medical Examination (Vision, Hearing, Color Blindness, and Physical Deformity check)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Complete verification of degree certificates, Odia pass standard, and certified medical fitness

financial_package.note: Sub-Inspectors of Police in Odisha are appointed at Pay Matrix Level 9 under the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017 (Pay Scale ₹35,400 - ₹1,12,400 with entry basic pay of ₹35,400). SIs are entitled to dedicated police service allowances including ration allowance, uniform allowance, investigation kit allowance, and government quarter accommodation.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017, Finance Department, Government of Odisha
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated on entry basic pay of ₹35,400 + 58% Dearness Allowance (₹20,532) + House Rent Allowance (9% to 18%: ₹3,186 to ₹6,372 depending on posting in rural police station vs Bhubaneswar-Cuttack Police Commissionerate) + Monthly Police Ration Allowance (~₹2,000) + Kit Maintenance / Uniform Allowance (~₹1,200) + Medical Allowance (₹500). Statutory deductions include 10% NPS (Basic + DA = ₹5,593), Professional Tax (₹200), and Police Benevolent Fund / GIS (~₹350).
official_perks: Designated officer accommodation / police quarters at Thana / Sub-Division campus, or House Rent Allowance (9% to 18%)
Monthly Police Ration Allowance / Diet Allowance sanctioned by Home Department
Uniform grant and monthly kit maintenance allowance
Comprehensive medical treatment reimbursement under Odisha Government Servants' Medical Attendance Rules and Police Hospitals
Dearness Allowance (DA) linked to state government revisions
Contributory pension coverage under New Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% state government matching contribution
Mobile SIM connection / official communication allowance for investigative field duties
